title: Con todo respeto
setting: Don Emilio's measurement is wrong. You are certain, and he has worked here since before you were born.

options.es: Con todo respeto, don Emilio, ¿tiene un minuto?
options.en: With all respect, don Emilio, do you have a minute?
options.feedback: The permission comes before the problem. That phrase is what makes everything after it possible.

options.en: Don Emilio, I found a mistake.
options.feedback: The word error, in the first sentence, in a workshop where four people can hear.
No greeting, no permission, and the fault named out loud. He will not look at it now.

options.es: Yo debo estar equivocado, pero esta medida no me da.
options.en: I must be mistaken, but this measurement does not work out for me.
options.feedback: The mistake stays on your side of the bench until he chooses to pick it up. That is the whole technique.

options.es: Creo que hay un error en el número.
options.en: I think there is a mistake in the number.
options.feedback: Softened with creo, which helps. It still puts the error on his paper.

options.es: Usted puso ciento veinte y son ciento diez.
options.en: You put a hundred and twenty and it is a hundred and ten.
options.feedback: Correct, and it is a verdict delivered in front of the shop.

steps.speaker: Don Emilio
steps.en: (looks at the paper for thirty seconds) Ah.

options.feedback: He is deciding whether to pick up the pencil. Anything you say in that gap takes the decision away from him.

options.en: Do you see what I mean?
options.feedback: Almost harmless. It also asks him to agree out loud that he was wrong.

options.es: Sí, yo sabía que estaba mal.
options.en: Yes, I knew it was wrong.
options.feedback: Everything you built with the first three sentences, undone in one.

steps.speaker: Don Emilio
steps.es: (cambia el número él mismo) Así sí le da.
steps.en: (changes the number himself) That way it works out.

options.feedback: Two words and back to work. Nobody mentions it again, which is the point.
Fine. Perfecto puts a small spotlight on the correction.
Summarising it out loud is the one thing that turns a private fix into a public one.
